## Hypothesis

The TRENDLINE_BREAK_CALL_VETO candidate aims to capture the edge present in vetoing call entries when a bearish trendline break is confirmed. This hypothesis is based on the observation that such breaks often lead to a continuation of the bearish trend, making call entries less favorable.

## Mechanism

The mechanism involves identifying bearish trendline breaks and using this information to veto call entries. The trendline break is detected by analyzing the price action and identifying instances where the price breaks through a previously established trendline. If a bearish trendline break is confirmed, the system will veto any call entries, as these are likely to be against the prevailing trend.
